title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 401) reviews: U.S. commits ₦5bn to document religious freedom abuses

content.rendered:
The United States has announced a $3.5 million fund, estimated at about ₦5 billion, to support the documentation and reporting of religious freedom abuses in Nigeria.

The move has sparked conversations about insecurity, accountability, and why international organisations appear increasingly focused on documenting Nigeria’s crises while many citizens continue to demand stronger action to prevent violence in the first place.
